policy.name: Andhra Pradesh MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) - 'One Entrepreneur, One Family by 2030'
policy.order_no: G.O.Ms.No.69, Industries & Commerce (Programme-I) Department, dated 26-10-2024; amended by G.O.Ms.No.22 dated 17-02-2025 (eligibility and capital subsidy paras, enhanced incentives for SC/ST/women/BC/minority)

schemes.name: Investment (capital) subsidy - General category
schemes.clause: MSME&EDP 4.0 - Investment Subsidy (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY: ICAI MSME & Startup Committee handbook 'Andhra Pradesh State MSME Policy' (startup.icai.org, 2026) and KIP Financial summary; official G.O. could not be downloaded (apmsmeone.ap.gov.in unreachable). 25% of Fixed Capital Investment; caps micro Rs 25 lakh (disbursed over 2 yrs), small Rs 1.5 crore (3 yrs), medium Rs 7 crore (4 yrs). Both sources agree on these figures. Overall incentives under all packages capped at 75% of FCI (Finance Dept condition quoted in G.O. preamble per search snippet). Manufacturing only; new units and expansion (>=25% increase).

schemes.name: Investment subsidy - Special category (Women/SC/ST/BC/Minority/specially-abled)
schemes.clause: MSME&EDP 4.0 as amended by G.O.Ms.No.22 dt 17-02-2025 (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY: ICAI MSME & Startup Committee handbook 'Andhra Pradesh State MSME Policy' (startup.icai.org, 2026) and KIP Financial summary; official G.O. could not be downloaded (apmsmeone.ap.gov.in unreachable). ICAI: micro 45% (Rs 45 lakh), small 45% (Rs 4.5 crore), medium 35% (Rs 7 crore). CONFLICT: KIP Financial says 35% up to Rs 7 crore for all special categories (likely pre-amendment). Women: ICAI also mentions '10% additional investment subsidy'.

schemes.name: Net SGST reimbursement
schemes.clause: MSME&EDP 4.0 - Net SGST reimbursement (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY: ICAI MSME & Startup Committee handbook 'Andhra Pradesh State MSME Policy' (startup.icai.org, 2026) and KIP Financial summary; official G.O. could not be downloaded (apmsmeone.ap.gov.in unreachable). ICAI: 100% of net SGST for 5 years or until 100% of FCI realised (rate_by_zone = FCI ceiling), additionally capped at 5% of annual turnover (as summarised - unclear if annual cap). Applies to manufacturing and service.

schemes.name: Power cost reimbursement
schemes.clause: MSME&EDP 4.0 - Power cost reimbursement (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY: ICAI MSME & Startup Committee handbook 'Andhra Pradesh State MSME Policy' (startup.icai.org, 2026) and KIP Financial summary; official G.O. could not be downloaded (apmsmeone.ap.gov.in unreachable). ICAI: Rs 1/unit for 5 years from commercial production, annual cap micro Rs 1 lakh, small Rs 5 lakh, medium Rs 15 lakh; special category Rs 1.5/unit with same caps. cap field left null because caps are per year and per size.

schemes.name: Quality certification cost support (top-up to GoI schemes)
schemes.clause: MSME&EDP 4.0 - Quality certification (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY: ICAI MSME & Startup Committee handbook 'Andhra Pradesh State MSME Policy' (startup.icai.org, 2026) and KIP Financial summary; official G.O. could not be downloaded (apmsmeone.ap.gov.in unreachable). ICAI: 100% reimbursement of certification charges incl. consultancy, as top-up over GoI support (balance after central assistance); cap not given in summary.

schemes.name: Technology upgradation subsidy (existing units modernisation)
schemes.clause: MSME&EDP 4.0 - Technology upgradation (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY: ICAI MSME & Startup Committee handbook 'Andhra Pradesh State MSME Policy' (startup.icai.org, 2026) and KIP Financial summary; official G.O. could not be downloaded (apmsmeone.ap.gov.in unreachable). General 20% (micro Rs 20 lakh/2 yrs, small Rs 2 crore/3 yrs, medium Rs 5 crore/5 yrs); special category 40% (micro Rs 40 lakh, small Rs 4 crore, medium Rs 5 crore). Mutually exclusive with capital subsidy per Finance Dept remark.

other_benefits: Stamp duty & transfer duty: 100% reimbursement on purchase/lease of industrial land and buildings (secondary).
Land cost rebate: SC/ST micro & small, 75% up to Rs 25 lakh in APIIC parks, new units only (secondary).
Business Development Credits for medium enterprises: 2% of growth in turnover for 5 years (secondary).
Export: 1% of export turnover for 3 years (secondary).
No interest subsidy for MSMEs found in summaries (8% interest subsidy is under AP Innovation & Startup Policy 4.0). No electricity duty exemption found.
